page.overview:
Who is Meilyn Arganya?

Meilyn Arganya was an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She had one Warder named Andro.

She was a tall woman with silver-gray hair, a thrusting chin, a smooth face, and "startling" blue eyes.

She was exceptionally strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of . Except for Cadsuane Melaidhrin, she was the strongest channeler the White Tower had seen in six hundred years.

She went to the White Tower in at the age of 16. She spent 7 years as a novice and 6 as Accepted. She was raised to the shawl in at the age of 29.
